title: Traceable clinical evidence: citation click-through and bidirectional linking

test_cases.name: CitationDataModel parses reasoning event into structured citations
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect index.html for CitationDataModel class and extraction methods
test_cases.evidence: CitationDataModel defined with structured and heuristic citation extraction

test_cases.name: Clicking diagnosis navigates to and highlights supporting transcript sentence
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect EvidenceHighlightEngine methods and scrollIntoView integration
test_cases.expected_result: EvidenceHighlightEngine scrolls to and pulses matching transcript text
test_cases.evidence: EvidenceHighlightEngine implements smooth scrolling and pulse highlighting

test_cases.name: Bidirectional citation markers in transcript
test_cases.input_setup: Check for citation badge injection and two-way jump links
test_cases.expected_result: Bidirectional badges inserted into transcript linking to diagnoses
test_cases.evidence: Bidirectional badges link transcript sentences back to diagnostic codes

test_cases.name: Citation preview tooltip / card
test_cases.expected_result: Tooltip component presents code description and supporting text
test_cases.evidence: Citation tooltip component defined with debounced preview

test_cases.name: Accessibility announcements for citation navigation
test_cases.input_setup: Check for aria-live or sr-announce container in index.html
test_cases.expected_result: ARIA live region updates when citation navigation occurs
test_cases.evidence: Screen-reader announcements present for accessible citation navigation
